summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV filed an 8-K reporting an extraordinary general meeting where shareholders approved an extension of the deadline to consummate a business combination from July 16, 2026 to January 16, 2027, with the board authorized to extend further in one-month increments up to July 16, 2027. This is a routine SPAC extension filing to provide more time to find an acquisition target, not a special situation event. The filing includes amendments to the articles of incorporation and results of shareholder votes. No deal terms or strategic transaction are involved; it is purely an administrative extension to avoid liquidation.
